events.description: Approved a 7.3% increase in the quarterly dividend rate to $0.44 per common share, up from the previous rate of $0.41 per common share
events.source_quote: During the third quarter of 2012, Altria Group, Inc.'s Board of Directors approved a 7.3% increase in the quarterly dividend rate to $0.44 per common share versus the previous rate of $0.41 per common share.
events.section: Note 1. Background and Basis of Presentation

events.description: Repurchased 19.6 million shares of common stock at an aggregate cost of approximately $622 million (average price of $31.76 per share) during the nine months ended September 30, 2012
events.source_quote: During the nine and three months ended September 30, 2012, Altria Group, Inc. repurchased 19.6 million shares (aggregate cost of approximately $622 million, and $31.76 average price per share) and 7.7 million shares (aggregate cost of approximately $262 million, and $34.25 average price per share), respectively.
events.section: Note 1. Background and Basis of Presentation

events.description: Authorized the expansion of the outstanding share repurchase program from $1.0 billion to $1.5 billion
events.source_quote: On October 23, 2012, Altria Group, Inc.'s Board of Directors authorized the expansion of the current share repurchase program from $1.0 billion to $1.5 billion.
events.section: Note 1. Background and Basis of Presentation

events.description: Reorganized Middleton as a wholly-owned subsidiary of PM USA effective January 1, 2012 as part of the 2011 Cost Reduction Program
events.source_quote: The combination of these two formerly separate segments is related to the restructuring associated with a cost reduction program announced in October 2011 (the '2011 Cost Reduction Program'). Also, in connection with the 2011 Cost Reduction Program, effective January 1, 2012, Middleton became a wholly-owned subsidiary of PM USA, reflecting management's goal to achieve efficiencies in the management of these businesses.

events.description: Issued $1.9 billion of 2.850% senior unsecured notes due 2022 and $0.9 billion of 4.250% senior unsecured notes due 2042
events.source_quote: on August 9, 2012, Altria Group, Inc. issued $1.9 billion aggregate principal amount of 2.850% senior unsecured long-term notes due 2022 and $0.9 billion aggregate principal amount of 4.250% senior unsecured long-term notes due 2042.

events.description: Repaid in full $600 million aggregate principal amount of UST senior unsecured notes upon maturity
events.source_quote: In July 2012, senior unsecured notes issued by UST in the aggregate principal amount of $600 million matured and were repaid in full.

events.description: Paid approximately $262,000 in May 2012 to satisfy and conclude the F. Campbell Engle progeny litigation
events.source_quote: In May 2012, PM USA paid an amount of approximately $262,000 in satisfaction of the judgment and associated costs and interest. This litigation has concluded.

events.description: Broward County jury returned a zero damages verdict in the Hancock case on August 10, 2012, with PM USA's final comparative fault liability set at approximately $700
events.source_quote: August 2012 Hancock On August 10, 2012, a Broward County jury returned a verdict in the amount of zero damages and allocated 5% of the fault to each of the defendants (PM USA and R.J. Reynolds)... PM USA's portion of the damages was approximately $700.
